heroSummary: LAUSD's fall calendar begins with a four-day Admission Day and Labor Day weekend, followed by Unassigned Days on September 21 and October 11. Farm Workers Day and Armenian Genocide Remembrance Day create additional district holidays before the April 10–14 Spring Recess.

whatsNew.title: What's Different in 2027–2028
content: The first day remains August 12, shifting from Wednesday in 2026 to Thursday in 2027.
Spring Recess shifts from March 22–26 in 2026–27 to April 10–14 in 2027–28.
The district calendar’s listed last day moves from June 4 to June 7. Schools that use January 10 as a pupil-free day use June 8 as an instructional day.
Armenian Genocide Remembrance Day is listed as a no-school day on April 24, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every LAUSD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. This page covers LAUSD’s districtwide instructional calendar. School events, early-dismissal days, affiliated charter calendars, and some program calendars may differ.

calendarFaqs.q: Are students off for the full week of Thanksgiving?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Students are off November 22–26, 2027. LAUSD designates November 22–24 as unassigned days and November 25–26 as the Thanksgiving Holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all students return on January 10?
calendarFaqs.a: January 10 is the district calendar’s second-semester start date. LAUSD notes that a school may use January 10 as a pupil-free day; if it does, June 8 becomes an instructional day.

calendarFaqs.q: Are minimum days and early-dismissal days included?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Minimum days, early-dismissal days, conferences, and campus events are usually published by individual schools. Ask your school for its site calendar.

Reviewed every date shown in the student calendar table against LAUSD’s official 2027–28 instructional calendar, including the January 10 pupil-free option and the conditional June 8 instructional day.
Thanksgiving week is modeled as November 22–26 because students are off all week: November 22–24 are unassigned days and November 25–26 are the Thanksgiving Holiday.
The second semester begins January 10. The official calendar notes that a school may use January 10 as a pupil-free day; if it does, June 8 becomes an instructional day.
The official PDF includes an internally inconsistent pupil-free-day footnote. This page follows the visual calendar and the January 10 / June 8 conditional rule.
The year-over-year comparison uses LAUSD’s official 2026–27 and 2027–28 instructional calendars.
